image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a mud turtle partially submerged in water. The head is extended, showing a pointed snout and lateral eye. The carapace is dark, high-domed, and appears slightly glossy/wet. The plastron (underside shell) is visible along the edge, appearing yellowish-orange with dark markings. The skin on the neck is textured and grey-green. The background is blurred water/surface reflection.
